configuration.controls: One sequential Python process, no workers, parsed resident inputs, fixed seed and payload sizes; GC and verifier unchanged. Case order reshuffled per block; component order reshuffled per iteration. Full-call samples collected separately before component samples within each case/block. No clock pinning, CPU isolation or cache flushing. No network or signing in timed regions.

metric_definitions.authority_check_ns: Direct check_authority: grants, scopes, threshold, authority payload construction, hashing and signatures.
metric_definitions.core_digest_ns: compute_core_digest(core), including normalization, tagged JCS and SHA-256.
metric_definitions.effective_I_bel_ns: Policy-selected I_bel component: check_attestation if required, otherwise the same sample as native_I_bel.
metric_definitions.effective_I_hist_ns: Policy-selected I_hist component: check_attestation if required, otherwise the same sample as native_I_hist.
metric_definitions.effective_I_norm_ns: Policy-selected I_norm component: check_attestation if required, otherwise the same sample as native_I_norm.
metric_definitions.effective_I_rel_ns: Policy-selected I_rel component: check_attestation if required, otherwise the same sample as native_I_rel.
metric_definitions.effective_I_temp_ns: Policy-selected I_temp component: check_attestation if required, otherwise the same sample as native_I_temp.
metric_definitions.native_I_bel_ns: Direct native I_bel predicate. Counterfactual in externally attested cases; not executed in that case's total verifier path.
metric_definitions.native_I_hist_ns: Direct native I_hist predicate. Counterfactual in externally attested cases; not executed in that case's total verifier path.
metric_definitions.native_I_norm_ns: Direct native I_norm predicate. Counterfactual in externally attested cases; not executed in that case's total verifier path.
metric_definitions.native_I_rel_ns: Direct native I_rel predicate. Counterfactual in externally attested cases; not executed in that case's total verifier path.
metric_definitions.native_I_temp_ns: Direct native I_temp predicate. Counterfactual in externally attested cases; not executed in that case's total verifier path.
metric_definitions.proposal_digest_ns: compute_proposal_digest(q), including normalization, tagged JCS and SHA-256.
metric_definitions.provenance_check_ns: Direct check_provenance: declarations, in-memory resolver lookups and evidence hashes; no network I/O.
metric_definitions.receipt_signature_check_ns: verify_signature for one receipt: prepared unsigned payload, key/signature decoding, tagged hash, Ed25519 verification and historical key checks.
metric_definitions.signature_primitive_ns: Individual Ed25519 primitive timings from full verification, pooled per case across actual calls; call index preserved in signature_samples.csv.
metric_definitions.signature_primitive_sum_ns: Sum of Ed25519 primitive timings captured inside this full verification; excludes key parsing and message hashing, includes existing timer bookkeeping overhead.
metric_definitions.stage_1_lineage_ns: Existing verifier stage timer; includes diagnostic condition construction. Components/stages overlap and must not be summed with other metrics.
metric_definitions.stage_2_authority_ns: Existing verifier stage timer; includes diagnostic condition construction. Components/stages overlap and must not be summed with other metrics.
metric_definitions.stage_3_provenance_ns: Existing verifier stage timer; includes diagnostic condition construction. Components/stages overlap and must not be summed with other metrics.
metric_definitions.stage_4_state_application_ns: Existing verifier stage timer; includes diagnostic condition construction. Components/stages overlap and must not be summed with other metrics.
metric_definitions.stage_5_semantics_ns: Existing verifier stage timer; includes diagnostic condition construction. Components/stages overlap and must not be summed with other metrics.
metric_definitions.state_application_ns: apply_mutations: deep state copy, ordered operations and final state hash. Candidate equality checks belong to stage 4, not this component.
metric_definitions.state_hash_candidate_ns: compute_state_digest(candidate), same boundary as predecessor hash.
metric_definitions.state_hash_predecessor_ns: compute_state_digest(predecessor): model projection, normalization, tagged RFC 8785 JCS and SHA-256; derived state_digest excluded.
metric_definitions.total_cct_ns: External wall clock around the complete diagnostic verifier, including report construction; parsed objects and resident evidence.
metric_definitions.total_process_cpu_ns: Process CPU time around the same call, including the two wall-clock reads; diagnostic only, not used for latency plots.
